description:
his is a marketplace-optimized eCommerce video for sports shoes, created entirely without any physical shoot.

The video begins with a clean 3D turntable sequence, showcasing the shoes from every angle — highlighting design, mesh texture, sole structure, grip pattern, and overall build quality with high precision.

Using semi-CGI techniques, we ensure accurate product representation while enabling fast, scalable production.

It then takes viewers through:
• Key product features
• Material and build quality highlights
• Sole grip and cushioning details
• Design and structure visualization
• Trust-building visual cues

The turntable format ensures complete product visibility, helping customers evaluate performance, comfort, and design with clarity.

The video concludes with a minimal lifestyle integration, reinforcing how the product fits into active, everyday use.

V4b.ai is an Agency creating Content & Videos Without Any Physical Shoot, using high-end GPU Computers powering CGI, VFX, and AI, operated by specialists. Even before we start production, our AI-powered CGI experts use shared and available product images to create perfect digital double / precise 3D model of client’s product for product accuracy in the final video, then producing Marketplace-Optimized Videos & Images, that increase ‘Add-to-Cart’ by building customer trust, ready to get listed on Amazon, Shopify & more.

From Concept to Final Cut, we create Ad Films - Our custom production tech-stack helps our creative team with realistic environments, lifelike AI humans, multi-language voiceovers and dialogues. No sets. No actors. Just Platform-Optimized Films ready for YouTube, Meta, TV, OTT & more.
